dialogues.jp: 環の巫女同好会が終わり、一緒に桜並木を歩く。
dialogues.en:
After Tamaki's business with her Miko Association club, we
walked back home through the Sakura Avenue.
dialogues.text:
After Tamaki's business with her Miko Association club, we
walked back home through the Sakura Avenue.

dialogues.jp:
と、言っても、部員一人だから、好きな時間に
帰れそうなものなのだが……。
dialogues.en:
"Business" of sorts anyway, which isn't much when there's
only one member...
dialogues.text:
"Business" of sorts anyway, which isn't much when there's
only one member...

dialogues.jp:
そこは環の真面目なところで、きちんと時間ど
おりに始めて、終わらないと気が済まないらし
い。
dialogues.en:
Despite that though, Tamaki was insistent on beginning and
ending the club sessions on time.
dialogues.text:
Despite that though, Tamaki was insistent on beginning and
ending the club sessions on time.

dialogues.jp: 環らしいよな。
dialogues.en: That's just like her.
dialogues.text: That's just like her.

dialogues.jp: 俺とは大違いだ。
dialogues.en: And completely unlike me.
dialogues.text: And completely unlike me.

dialogues.jp:
ま、違う人間同士だから、一緒にいたいと思う
のかもしれないな。
dialogues.en:
The two of us, as different as night and day, it's a wonder
that we're together.
dialogues.text:
The two of us, as different as night and day, it's a wonder
that we're together.

dialogues.jp:
こうやって二人で歩いてるだけで、何となく心
が和むのも、一緒にいたいからだし。
dialogues.en:
Walking together like this, our hearts calm, and wanting to
be together even more.
dialogues.text:
Walking together like this, our hearts calm, and wanting to
be together even more.

dialogues.jp:
環に何かあったら、支えてやりたいと思うのも、
そういうことなのだろう。
dialogues.en:
What happens to her, I'm going to be there to be her pillar
of support.
dialogues.text:
What happens to her, I'm going to be there to be her pillar
of support.

dialogues.jp: 「なあ、環」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Tamaki."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Tamaki."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、昨日の昼から気になっていることを問い
かける。
dialogues.en:
Remembering the events at yesterday's lunch, I grabbed her
attention.
dialogues.text:
Remembering the events at yesterday's lunch, I grabbed her
attention.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい。何でしょう？」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.jp: 環はいつも通りの笑顔を向ける。
dialogues.en: She showed her ever-willing smile to me.
dialogues.text: She showed her ever-willing smile to me.

dialogues.jp:
「昨日の昼休みさ、お前の周りに人が集まって
　ただろ？」
dialogues.en:
"During yesterday's lunch break, there were lots of people
gathering around you, right?"
dialogues.text:
"During yesterday's lunch break, there were lots of people
gathering around you, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Correct."
dialogues.text: "Correct."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あいつらの未来、結局見てやったのか？」
dialogues.en: "Did you end up seeing their futures?"
dialogues.text: "Did you end up seeing their futures?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい。見ましたけど……。それが、何か？」
dialogues.en: "Yes, I did... why?"
dialogues.text: "Yes, I did... why?"

dialogues.jp: やっぱり。
dialogues.en: Just as I thought.
dialogues.text: Just as I thought.

dialogues.jp:
環のことだから、頼まれれば嫌とは言えないだ
ろうということは推測できる。
dialogues.en:
The way Tamaki is... she's the kind of girl that finds it
impossible to say no to a request.
dialogues.text:
The way Tamaki is... she's the kind of girl that finds it
impossible to say no to a request.

dialogues.jp:
人間、誰かから頼りにされると、迷惑な反面嬉
しくもある。
dialogues.en:
Humans want to be needed... it's annoying at times, yet
gives a form of fulfillment.
dialogues.text:
Humans want to be needed... it's annoying at times, yet
gives a form of fulfillment.

dialogues.jp: 特に、淋しがりやであれば、なおさらだ。
dialogues.en: Especially in times of loneliness.
dialogues.text: Especially in times of loneliness.

dialogues.jp:
今までだって、環は予知能力を使ったお陰で、
辛い思いをしているはずなのに……。
dialogues.en:
But even now, using her power like this may bring forth
misfortune...
dialogues.text:
But even now, using her power like this may bring forth
misfortune...

dialogues.jp:
「あのな、無理して人の未来なんて、見ること
　無いんだぞ」
dialogues.en:
"You know, you don't have to see other people's future just
because they ask..."
dialogues.text:
"You know, you don't have to see other people's future just
because they ask..."

dialogues.jp:
余計なお節介なのかも知れないが、つい心配に
なって言ってしまう。
dialogues.en:
I may have been overstepping my boundaries, but I couldn't
just put away my worries either.
dialogues.text:
I may have been overstepping my boundaries, but I couldn't
just put away my worries either.

dialogues.jp: 昼間の女子学生たち。
dialogues.en: Those girls at that break period...
dialogues.text: Those girls at that break period...

dialogues.jp:
彼女達は、完全に環に近づいてきているのでは
なく、環の予知能力に近づいて来ている。
dialogues.en:
They didn't want to get close to Tamaki. They wanted to get
close to Tamaki's power.
dialogues.text:
They didn't want to get close to Tamaki. They wanted to get
close to Tamaki's power.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「どうせ、あいつら、いつかは手の平を返した
　ようにさ……」
dialogues.en: "It's okay to say no sometimes, to people like that..."
dialogues.text: "It's okay to say no sometimes, to people like that..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「もし、悪い未来なんか見えた日には……」
dialogues.en: "After all, what if you see another bad future...?"
dialogues.text: "After all, what if you see another bad future...?"

dialogues.jp:
彼らは、ただ、興味本位なだけだ。現実と向合
おうとしていないだけだ。
dialogues.en:
In the end, they just want to know their futures...
something they can't attain in their realities.
dialogues.text:
In the end, they just want to know their futures...
something they can't attain in their realities.

dialogues.jp: そして、環のことなんて、誰も──。
dialogues.en: But, who would be thinking of Tamaki...?
dialogues.text: But, who would be thinking of Tamaki...?

dialogues.jp: そう言いそうになり、思わず言葉を飲み込む。
dialogues.en: I swallowed hard at the thought of my own words.
dialogues.text: I swallowed hard at the thought of my own words.

dialogues.jp: 多分、本人も気づいていることだ。
dialogues.en: She's surely noticed it herself.
dialogues.text: She's surely noticed it herself.

dialogues.jp: 俺があえて、言うことではないのかもしれない。
dialogues.en: Things that we've went through, after all...
dialogues.text: Things that we've went through, after all...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「分かってます……」
dialogues.en: "That possibility is real..."
dialogues.text: "That possibility is real..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、どうして……」
dialogues.en: "Then, why are you...?"
dialogues.text: "Then, why are you...?"

dialogues.jp: 環はそこで、黙ってしまう。
dialogues.en: Tamaki remained silent.
dialogues.text: Tamaki remained silent.

dialogues.jp: ちょっと、問い詰め過ぎたかな？
dialogues.en: Did I say too much?
dialogues.text: Did I say too much?

dialogues.jp:
でも、環のことが心配で、つい聞かずにはいら
れない。
dialogues.en: But all I said, was out of concern for her...
dialogues.text: But all I said, was out of concern for her...

dialogues.jp: 環は、重々しく口を開く。
dialogues.en: After awhile, her mouth slowly opened again.
dialogues.text: After awhile, her mouth slowly opened again.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「……まあ、仕方ありません。実際見えるんで
　すし」
dialogues.en:
"...Well, it can't be helped. That's the facts of the
matter."
dialogues.text:
"...Well, it can't be helped. That's the facts of the
matter."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「だからって……」
dialogues.en: "Then..."
dialogues.text: "Then..."

dialogues.jp: だからって、見ることはない。
dialogues.en: Then, you shouldn't do it.
dialogues.text: Then, you shouldn't do it.

dialogues.jp:
相手の未来を見れば見るほど、環はその未来に
対して、責任を負わなくてはいけなくなる。
dialogues.en:
If she keeps looking at other people's futures, she'd one
day have to bring bad news.
dialogues.text:
If she keeps looking at other people's futures, she'd one
day have to bring bad news.

dialogues.jp: そんなこと、無理してすることじゃない。
dialogues.en: She shouldn't have to bear with that...
dialogues.text: She shouldn't have to bear with that...

dialogues.jp:
自分の未来だって、責任を取らなければならな
い時があるのに、人のものまで背負わなくてい
い。
dialogues.en:
While she should be responsible for her own future, why
should she have to be responsible for others'?
dialogues.text:
While she should be responsible for her own future, why
should she have to be responsible for others'?

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様……」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama..."

dialogues.jp: 環は笑顔で振り返る。
dialogues.en: She turned to me with a gentle smile.
dialogues.text: She turned to me with a gentle smile.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「心配してくれて、ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "Thank you for your concern."
dialogues.text: "Thank you for your concern."

dialogues.jp: 何か。
dialogues.en: Huh...
dialogues.text: Huh...

dialogues.jp: まだ照れくさい。
dialogues.en: I started to blush.
dialogues.text: I started to blush.

dialogues.jp: 俺の顔もにやけてきた。
dialogues.en: My face was growing continually red.
dialogues.text: My face was growing continually red.

dialogues.jp: 環も、ずっと笑顔のままだ。
dialogues.en: All the while, she continued smiling.
dialogues.text: All the while, she continued smiling.

dialogues.jp: 「どうしたんだよ。ずっと笑って」
dialogues.en: "Geez, you always have a smile on your face..."
dialogues.text: "Geez, you always have a smile on your face..."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、自分の照れを誤魔化すため、環に矛先を
向ける。
dialogues.en:
Attempting to deflect attention away from my embarassment, I
shot an attack at her.
dialogues.text:
Attempting to deflect attention away from my embarassment, I
shot an attack at her.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「だって。こんな素敵な未来が見えなかったな
　んて……」
dialogues.en:
"Yes... because I could never have seen such a wonderful
future as this..."
dialogues.text:
"Yes... because I could never have seen such a wonderful
future as this..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「みんなが知ったら、驚くだろうな、と思って」
dialogues.en: "If everyone saw it, I'm sure they'd be surprised."
dialogues.text: "If everyone saw it, I'm sure they'd be surprised."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ウフフ……」
dialogues.en: "Ehehe..."
dialogues.text: "Ehehe..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……ああ、そうだな」
dialogues.en: "...Yeah."
dialogues.text: "...Yeah."

dialogues.jp:
俺の顔が、照れているのを環にばれないように
祈りつつ。
dialogues.en: My face still beet red, I said a quiet prayer.
dialogues.text: My face still beet red, I said a quiet prayer.

dialogues.jp: これからだって、きっと素敵な未来が待ってる。
dialogues.en: That an even brighter future awaits.
dialogues.text: That an even brighter future awaits.

dialogues.jp:
二人で一緒にいれば、どんなことだって乗り越
えられる。
dialogues.en:
As long as we're together, we can overcome anything in our
path.
dialogues.text:
As long as we're together, we can overcome anything in our
path.

dialogues.jp: 未来は俺達の手の中だ。
dialogues.en: Our future is created by no one but ourselves.
dialogues.text: Our future is created by no one but ourselves.

dialogues.jp: みんなも、早くそのことに気がつけばいい。
dialogues.en:
If everyone just realizes that, there wouldn't be any
problems...
dialogues.text:
If everyone just realizes that, there wouldn't be any
problems...

dialogues.jp: そうすれば、未来がもっと楽しみになる。
dialogues.en: And the future will become even more enjoyable.
dialogues.text: And the future will become even more enjoyable.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、環と一緒にいられれば……きっと……。
dialogues.en: As long as we're together... definitely...
dialogues.text: As long as we're together... definitely...

dialogues.jp: なんだか、緊張する。
dialogues.en: The tension in the air was unnerving.
dialogues.text: The tension in the air was unnerving.

dialogues.jp:
その緊張を隠すように、テレビを見ているのだ
が、落ち着かない。
dialogues.en: Watching the television did nothing to distract me from it.
dialogues.text: Watching the television did nothing to distract me from it.

dialogues.jp: テレビの音声が、右耳から左耳へと流れていく。
dialogues.en:
All the sounds emitting from the television went in one ear,
and out the other.
dialogues.text:
All the sounds emitting from the television went in one ear,
and out the other.

dialogues.jp:
努めて普通に振舞おうとしているが、つい気に
なって、台所を意識してしまう。
dialogues.en:
No matter how hard I tried, I couldn't keep my attention
away from the kitchen.
dialogues.text:
No matter how hard I tried, I couldn't keep my attention
away from the kitchen.

dialogues.jp:
どういう流れでこうなったのか、よくわからな
いのだけれど、
dialogues.en: A while ago, I hadn't noticed anything,
dialogues.text: A while ago, I hadn't noticed anything,

dialogues.jp: 気が付くと、環と一緒にスーパーに入っていた。
dialogues.en:
But before I knew it, I was heading into a supermarket with
Tamaki.
dialogues.text:
But before I knew it, I was heading into a supermarket with
Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: そして、
dialogues.en: And,
dialogues.text: And,

dialogues.jp: 気が付くと、環はうちの台所に立っていた。
dialogues.en: There she was, standing in my kitchen.
dialogues.text: There she was, standing in my kitchen.

dialogues.jp: 『朝倉様のお夕食、お作りしましょうか？』
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama, would you like me to make your dinner?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama, would you like me to make your dinner?"

dialogues.jp: 『新婚』。
dialogues.en: "Newlyweds".
dialogues.text: "Newlyweds".

dialogues.jp: 『同棲』。
dialogues.en: "Living Together."
dialogues.text: "Living Together."

dialogues.jp: って！　俺は何を考えているんだ！
dialogues.en: Gah! What the hell am I thinking about!
dialogues.text: Gah! What the hell am I thinking about!

dialogues.jp: 何て不純な想像をしてるんだ！
dialogues.en: Why am I imagining such dirty things!
dialogues.text: Why am I imagining such dirty things!

dialogues.jp: 妄想退散！　思考浄化！
dialogues.en: God, clear and purify my mind and rid it of evil!
dialogues.text: God, clear and purify my mind and rid it of evil!

dialogues.jp:
と、思うのだが、このシチュエーションでは仕
方のないことなのかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
Though, thinking about my living situation, maybe this was
unavoidable.
dialogues.text:
Though, thinking about my living situation, maybe this was
unavoidable.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama."

dialogues.jp: 環が台所から、俺に話しかける。
dialogues.en: Tamaki called out to me, emerging from the kitchen.
dialogues.text: Tamaki called out to me, emerging from the kitchen.

dialogues.en: "Eh? What is it?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? What is it?"

dialogues.jp:
本当はソファーに正座をして、質問を聞いてし
まいそうな勢いだが、無理して平然を装う。
dialogues.en:
Although I was technically sitting on the sofa, I was so
nervous that the sound of her voice made me jump.
dialogues.text:
Although I was technically sitting on the sofa, I was so
nervous that the sound of her voice made me jump.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「味付けは、甘いほうがいいですか？　辛い方
　がお好きですか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you prefer sweet or spicy things?"
dialogues.text: "Do you prefer sweet or spicy things?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ、甘い方が、その……好きかな」
dialogues.en: "A, ah... sweet things... I guess."
dialogues.text: "A, ah... sweet things... I guess."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「わかりました。もう少し待ってくださいね」
dialogues.en: "Okay. Please wait a moment."
dialogues.text: "Okay. Please wait a moment."

dialogues.jp:
と、環はパタパタと音を立てて台所へ戻ってい
く。
dialogues.en: She pitter-pattered her way back into the kitchen.
dialogues.text: She pitter-pattered her way back into the kitchen.

dialogues.jp: あー。心臓止まるかと思った。
dialogues.en:
Ha~ah. I thought my heart was going to stop beating for a
second.
dialogues.text:
Ha~ah. I thought my heart was going to stop beating for a
second.

dialogues.jp:
大体、音夢以外の女の子が、音夢がいないとき
に家に来るのなんて、初めてだもんな。
dialogues.en:
This is pretty much the first time someone besides Nemu has
been in my house, alone with me.
dialogues.text:
This is pretty much the first time someone besides Nemu has
been in my house, alone with me.

dialogues.jp: 意識するな、と言う方が酷である。
dialogues.en: The situation though, was awful for my senses.
dialogues.text: The situation though, was awful for my senses.

dialogues.jp:
俺のために、夕食を作ってくれるというところ
でもう既に目頭にくるものが……。
dialogues.en:
Too many times have I gone through hardships from certain
people wanting to make my dinner for me...
dialogues.text:
Too many times have I gone through hardships from certain
people wanting to make my dinner for me...

dialogues.jp:
しかも、音夢と違って、あの弁当のうまさを考
えると、相当期待していい気がする。
dialogues.en:
Completely unlike Nemu though, I'm sure this meal will be
much more fitting to the mood.
dialogues.text:
Completely unlike Nemu though, I'm sure this meal will be
much more fitting to the mood.

dialogues.jp: 楽しみだな。
dialogues.en: It'd be fun, for sure.
dialogues.text: It'd be fun, for sure.

dialogues.jp: 何を作ってくれるんだろう。
dialogues.en: I wonder what she's making?
dialogues.text: I wonder what she's making?

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「お待たせしました」
dialogues.en: "My apologies for the wait."
dialogues.text: "My apologies for the wait."

dialogues.jp: 環はテーブルに料理を並べている。
dialogues.en: Tamaki effortlessly laid the table with plates of food.
dialogues.text: Tamaki effortlessly laid the table with plates of food.

dialogues.jp: 「おっ！」
dialogues.en: "Ohhh!"
dialogues.text: "Ohhh!"

dialogues.jp: やっぱりすごい。
dialogues.en: It looked delicious, as expected.
dialogues.text: It looked delicious, as expected.

dialogues.jp:
見た目にも鮮やかな和食が、テーブルの上に並
んでいる。
dialogues.en:
A full-course Japanese-style meal was laid out lovingly in
front of me.
dialogues.text:
A full-course Japanese-style meal was laid out lovingly in
front of me.

dialogues.jp: 「いっただっきまーす！」
dialogues.en: "Let's dig in~"
dialogues.text: "Let's dig in~"

dialogues.jp: 俺は箸を持ち、急いで食べ始める。
dialogues.en:
I quickly grabbed my chopsticks, in a hurry to devour the
food.
dialogues.text:
I quickly grabbed my chopsticks, in a hurry to devour the
food.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「ちょっと作りすぎてしまったので、たくさん
　食べてくださいね」
dialogues.en:
"I slightly overmade the portion, so please eat as much as
you like."
dialogues.text:
"I slightly overmade the portion, so please eat as much as
you like."

dialogues.jp: と、お茶を淹れてくれる。
dialogues.en: She said, as she calmly sipped her tea.
dialogues.text: She said, as she calmly sipped her tea.

dialogues.jp: 幸せだなあ。
dialogues.en: Ahh, bliss.
dialogues.text: Ahh, bliss.

dialogues.jp: 口いっぱいにご飯を詰め、幸せを噛みしめる。
dialogues.en:
My mouth was overwhelmed with tingling, joyous sensations as
the food entered it.
dialogues.text:
My mouth was overwhelmed with tingling, joyous sensations as
the food entered it.

dialogues.jp:
一緒にご飯を食べる……。一人で食べるよりも、
数倍おいしく感じる。
dialogues.en:
Eating dinner together... even if it was the same food, with
her around, it was several times more enjoyable.
dialogues.text:
Eating dinner together... even if it was the same food, with
her around, it was several times more enjoyable.

dialogues.jp:
好きな子が作ってくれた、ってだけでおいしい
のに、普通に食べてもおいしいなんて……。
dialogues.en:
Eating the delicious food the girl you love prepared for
you...
dialogues.text:
Eating the delicious food the girl you love prepared for
you...

dialogues.jp: 申し分ないです。
dialogues.en: Absolutely nothing better.
dialogues.text: Absolutely nothing better.

dialogues.jp: この茶碗蒸しだって、絶妙だ。
dialogues.en: This custard egg dish especially, heaven.
dialogues.text: This custard egg dish especially, heaven.

dialogues.jp: 今すぐ料理屋を開けるのでは？
dialogues.en: Is she going to open up a restaurant?
dialogues.text: Is she going to open up a restaurant?

dialogues.jp: 感動をかみ締めつつ、言葉を失う。
dialogues.en: The sheer happiness put me at a loss for words.
dialogues.text: The sheer happiness put me at a loss for words.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あの……どうでしょうか？」
dialogues.en: "Um... is something wrong?"
dialogues.text: "Um... is something wrong?"

dialogues.jp: 環は、上目遣いで俺に尋ねる。
dialogues.en: Tamaki peered at me from below.
dialogues.text: Tamaki peered at me from below.

dialogues.jp: 「…………もぐもぐ」
dialogues.en: "......Mrmmrmrph."
dialogues.text: "......Mrmmrmrph."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様？」
